Terri Pickens for Idaho Press Release Terri Pickens Releases First Campaign Ad Terri Pickens, Democratic candidate for Idaho governor, released her first campaign ad of 2026. The ad highlights top priorities: education funding, help for early-career workers, support for small business, tax relief for homeowners, opposition to state and federal overreach into individual freedom, and unambiguous protection for Idaho public lands. “Idaho voters tell me they want better leadership than what they’ve been getting,” Pickens said. “They are excited about having a governor who really cares about regular folks and won’t knuckle-under to a Legislature that wants to tell us how to live our lives or a federal government that doesn’t respect individual freedom.” View ad: https://youtu.be/mldu_YVRmTE Pickens understands that she can’t run the lazy, bloated election campaign that Brad Little is running. She doesn’t rake in cash from deep-pocket lobbyists, major CEOs, and other wealthy insiders. However, Pickens has raised nearly $90,000 and travels the state and uses social media platforms and volunteers to spread the message. Pickens just finished a campaign swing through northern Idaho, where big crowds showed up, despite lovely spring weather. More than 70 people showed up in Osburn, Idaho, for an event organized by Shoshone County Dems. Pickens grew up in Pocatello, part of a family that worked construction. She is a mom, a lawyer, and a small business owner. She credits Idaho public schools and public lands for shaping her into the successful person she is today. For more information visit her website: Terri Pickens for Idaho Contact: Dean Ferguson 208-790-4530 dean@terriforidaho.com # # #
